shared_or_similar_visual_information: The lens-shaped region inside both circular outlines. On the left, use the tan lens labeled 11 between Coffee and Tea. On the right, use the tan lens labeled 9 between Climate Change and Deforestation.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The lens represents respondents who prefer both Coffee and Tea. Right image: The lens represents respondents concerned about both issues.
Rationales: The selected region lies within both labeled contours in each diagram, which assigns simultaneous membership in the two sets.
